query.text: exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmkho c on a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_kho', '@@key', '', @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId

finding.text:
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = '' if @ma_vt <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_vt like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_vt) + '%''' if @ma_kho_nhap <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_kho like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_kho_nhap) + '%''' if @ma_lo <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_lo like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_lo) + '%''' if @ma_vi_tri <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_vi_tri like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_vi_tri) + '%''' if @ma_vi_trin <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_vi_trin like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_vi_trin) + '%''' if @strDetailKey <> '' set @strDetailKey = ' and exists(select 1 from d75 x where a.id = x.id ' + @strDetailKey + ')'
set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding + ' and ' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionGetUnitIDRightKeys(@@admin, @@userId, @ma_unit, 'a.unit_id') + @strDetailKey exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmkho c on a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_kho', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId
